top_findings: Homepage and contact page titles/descriptions are Cursor's, not Asclevor's (wrong brand on 2 of 4 pages)
Hero image alt text reads 'Cursor app screenshot'
~37.6 MB uncompressed media; two autoplay MP4s (14 MB + 6.9 MB) use preload=auto with no poster
No sitemap.xml (404), no canonical tags, no Open Graph/Twitter tags, zero JSON-LD structured data
Thin content: 95-215 words per page; no llms.txt
quick_wins: Add static/sitemap.xml + robots.txt Sitemap directive (15 min)
Shared head component: canonical + OG/Twitter tags + one 1200x630 OG image (45 min)
Convert 5 PNGs to WebP and re-encode 2 MP4s: 37.6 MB to ~3 MB (60 min)

categories.name: Technical SEO
what_works: Full SSR HTML on all 4 routes, all return 200, no noindex

findings.title: No XML sitemap
findings.description: /sitemap.xml returns 404.
findings.recommendation: Add static/sitemap.xml with all 4 URLs; reference from robots.txt.

findings.title: No canonical tags
findings.description: Zero rel=canonical across pages; apex 308-redirects to www, duplicate-signal risk.
findings.recommendation: Add canonical to every page standardizing on https://www.asclevor.com.

findings.title: robots.txt missing Sitemap directive
findings.description: No Sitemap: line.
findings.recommendation: Add Sitemap: https://www.asclevor.com/sitemap.xml.

findings.title: Production security headers unverified
findings.description: adapter-auto, no svelte.config.js; deploy target undetected.
findings.recommendation: Ensure HSTS, X-Content-Type-Options, Referrer-Policy at host; confirm apex->www 308.

findings.title: No prerendering
findings.description: Static marketing pages not prerendered.
findings.recommendation: export const prerender = true.

findings.title: Invalid meta tag
findings.description: <meta name="text-scale" content="scale"> in app.html is nonstandard.
findings.recommendation: Remove it.

findings.title: Wrong-brand copy on homepage and contact
findings.description: Titles/descriptions say 'Cursor · The AI Code Editor' / 'Contact the Cursor team' (src/routes/+page.svelte:11-12, src/routes/contact/+page.svelte:44-48).
findings.recommendation: Replace with Asclevor-branded metadata.

findings.title: Thin content
findings.description: 134/156/215/95 words on /, /api, /pricing, /contact.
findings.recommendation: Expand homepage past 300 words with outcomes and proof; add endpoint/code specifics to /api.

findings.title: No authority layer
findings.description: No case studies, blog, or named expertise for a clinical data product.
findings.recommendation: Add compliance strip (SOC 2/HIPAA-eligibility/data sourcing); plan content hub on main domain.

findings.title: No content hub on main domain
findings.description: Docs and app live on subdomains; no blog/changelog on www.
findings.recommendation: Publish use-case/blog content on www.asclevor.com.

findings.title: 2 of 4 titles/descriptions wrong brand
findings.description: See Content Quality.
findings.recommendation: Rewrite metadata.

findings.title: No social sharing metadata
findings.description: No OG or Twitter tags; no OG image asset exists.
findings.recommendation: Shared head component + 1200x630 OG image under 300 KB.

findings.title: Sparse heading structure
findings.description: 0-2 H2s per page; feature sections may lack real heading tags.
findings.recommendation: Use H2/H3 for feature section titles.

findings.title: Generic alt text
findings.description: 'Mission Control', 'Cloud agents' describe feature names not content.
findings.recommendation: Describe what the images show.

categories.name: Schema / Structured Data
what_works: Clean head, easy to add JSON-LD

findings.title: Zero structured data
findings.description: No JSON-LD on any page.
findings.recommendation: Add Organization (+sameAs) site-wide; SoftwareApplication+offers on / and /pricing; WebSite; ContactPage. FAQPage optional (no Google SERP feature since May 2026). Never HowTo.

findings.title: 21 MB autoplay video downloaded on load
findings.description: ImgSlot.svelte renders <video preload="auto"> with no poster; case-search.mp4 is 14 MB, everywhere.mp4 6.9 MB.
findings.recommendation: preload=metadata, compressed posters, viewport-gated loading, re-encode to ~2.5 MB total.

findings.title: Oversized PNGs
findings.description: api-hero 2.3 MB, hero-app 1.9 MB, avatar 1.1 MB, plus 784 KB/612 KB.
findings.recommendation: WebP/AVIF conversion, lazy loading, width/height, fetchpriority=high on heroes.

findings.title: Render-blocking Google Fonts
findings.description: 2 families, 8 weights from fonts.googleapis.com.
findings.recommendation: Trim weights; consider self-hosting.

findings.title: No intrinsic media dimensions
findings.description: No width/height on video/img in ImgSlot.
findings.recommendation: Set aspect-ratio or dimension attributes.

categories.name: AI Search Readiness
what_works: SSR HTML fully readable by AI crawlers

findings.title: Wrong-brand metadata corrupts entity signals
findings.description: AI engines see 'Cursor' as the title of the brand page.
findings.recommendation: Fix metadata (Phase 1).

findings.title: No llms.txt
findings.description: /llms.txt 404.
findings.recommendation: Add llms.txt with product definition, pricing, API base URL, doc links.

findings.title: Low citability
findings.description: 95-215 words/page, few concrete specifics or numbers.
findings.recommendation: Add quotable factual passages: coverage stats, endpoints, compliance facts.

findings.title: Unoptimized media pipeline
findings.description: No WebP/AVIF, no lazy loading, no dimensions, ~37.6 MB total media.
findings.recommendation: Adopt @sveltejs/enhanced-img or vite-imagetools; convert and resize.

findings.title: No OG image asset
findings.description: No 1200x630 social preview exists.
findings.recommendation: Create one, under 300 KB.

findings.title: Wrong-brand alt
findings.description: Hero alt says 'Cursor app screenshot'.
findings.recommendation: Rewrite alt text.

phases.name: Phase 1: Critical Fixes
items: Video preload=metadata + posters + viewport gating; re-encode MP4s

phases.name: Phase 2: High-Impact Improvements
items: API page code sample and endpoint list

phases.name: Phase 3: Content & Authority
items: Expand homepage copy past 300 words with proof
Content hub plan for main domain

phases.name: Phase 4: Monitoring & Iteration
items: GSC sitemap submit + track brand impressions (4-week check)
Monthly AI-engine entity check for 'What is Asclevor?'
Re-run full audit after production deploy
